knowledge_graph.title: Kat Miller - Union Home Mortgage
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "After graduating from The University of Cincinnati, I started working as a Loan Officer for a mortgage company. I have now been in the mortgage industry for over 17 years. My focus is helping people find the right solution for their home buying or refinancing needs and helping them meet their financial goals. I have experience with various loan products such as Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA and Jumbo just to name a few. I pride myself on getting loans done quickly and efficiently and constantly striving to exceed my clients expectations. When I'm not working I enjoy spending time with my husband Dre, my daughter Phoenix and my son Pharaoh. NMLS 137532"
